# Gradient

> Gradient is the design system of Shades Media Group (Shades), a creative and technology agency in Chișinău, Moldova. It holds the Shades brand (logo, colour, type, the Spectra mascot family, voice, print rules) and the code every Shades product installs: the shades-gradient npm package with design tokens, CSS components, a Tailwind v4 theme and the Shades icon set.

## Facts

- Website: https://gradient.shades.md (English, French, Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Italian, Turkish, Hindi, Japanese, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese)
- Repository: https://github.com/Shades-Media-Group/gradient
- npm package: shades-gradient, version {{@version}}
- Licence: the code is MIT. The Shades name, logo and Spectra characters are trademarks of Shades Media Group and are not covered by the MIT licence.
- Logo: a sharp-cornered square in Shades Red #E40523 with three white bars at 100%, 75% and 50% opacity. The bars are the "shades"; together they make the gradient.
- Colour: Shades Red #E40523, an ink scale from #FDFDFC (paper) to #0A0A0B (ink), and a four-shade spectrum #6364FF, #D212D6, #E40523, #FF5900 used once per layout.
- Type: Space Grotesk for display, Hanken Grotesk for text, Inter for Cyrillic.
- Spectra family: Spectra (founder, welcome), Mera (strategy), Sol (art direction), Nova (labs, new features), Sage (help, docs), Vio (community), Sunny (production, success).
- Icons: 78 Shades interface icons on a 24 px grid with 2 px round strokes.
- Products built with the system: PageRecast (https://pagerecast.shades.md), nails-by-alynna, lms. Next: ImageReframe and the shades.md rebuild.
